instruction: Decompile a Ceph crush map for editing
Compile and set a Ceph crush map
output: crushtool -c crush.txt -o crush.new && ceph osd setcrushmap -i crush.new

instruction: Set Ceph pool application to RBD
output: ceph osd pool application enable mypool rbd

instruction: Set Ceph pool application to CephFS
output: ceph osd pool application enable cephfs_data cephfs

instruction: Add an OSD to Ceph from a device
List Ceph OSDs with their device class
Create a Ceph crush rule for SSD OSDs
output: ceph osd crush rule create-replicated ssd-rule default host ssd
ceph osd pool set mypool crush_rule ssd-rule
ceph osd erasure-code-profile set myprofile k=2 m=1

instruction: Create Ceph erasure-coded pool using a profile
output: ceph osd pool create ecpool 64 erasure myprofile

instruction: Enable Ceph application on an erasure-coded pool
output: ceph osd pool application enable ecpool rbd

instruction: List Ceph RBD images in a pool
Rollback a Ceph RBD to a snapshot
Map a Ceph RBD image locally
